title: Read a request body
summary: NestJS: Read a request body. Send an empty object.
introduction: @Body supplies parsed JSON. Send POST /books with application/json and {"title":"Moon Trip"}.
learningObjectives: Read a request body with NestJS

blocks.text: Create a practice project with npx @nestjs/cli new school. Replace src/main.ts with one complete example and run npm run start. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000. The original app files are unused by these small examples.

blocks.title: Read a request body

blocks.text: Body supplies the parsed object. The string check passes and its title is returned.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Check body fields instead of trusting the TypeScript shape.
